text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the library,
I saw Super Creek there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence~.
Are you looking for a book too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for reference books as well.
I've got homework for world history and classical Japanese, you see.
choice_data_list: Did you find a good book?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... there are so many varieties
that I'm completely spoiled for choice~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...! If it's okay with you,
please let me help you look for it...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, my~ Rob Roy-chan.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for interrupting.
I just happened to overhear your conversation...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all~! If you could help out, that would be a huge lifesaver♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Um, as a member of the library committee,
I'll be sure to find the perfect book for you...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Right off the bat, Creek-san,
I think I can highly recommend this reference book!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It has lots of annotations for related terms and plenty of
illustrations, making it remarkably easy to read...!
There are even humorous trivia snippets—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds wonderful~.
I can really tell how charming that book is♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I-I'm so sorry!
I ended up rambling on and on...!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really don't need to worry.
It's wonderful to get so absorbed in something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Have confidence in what you love, and let's keep developing it
into a strength you can be proud of♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much... I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to study using the reference books Rob Roy-chan recommends too. Come, let's look for them!♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...! There are other books that come to mind, so let's read and compare them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them continued
searching for reference books, but—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? This is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu... "Even then, the giant carrot wouldn't budge. Come, everyone, let's pull together!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, is that... a picture book?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry! I just thought the kids
would really love this picture book~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It really does look like a fascinating picture book.
The children's smiles... I can picture them too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...But I'll hold back for now!
I came here today to look for study guides!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umm, World History... World History...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? My, oh my~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look at this~.
I found a picture book that's perfect for Rob Roy-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh, to me...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's a story about a hero who slays an evil dragon♪
It sounds so~ very fun~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Is that the one that just came in stock...!?
I haven't had the chance to read it yet, but I think...
No, I'm absolutely certain I'll love this story!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you really do love this, don't you?
I'll read plenty more to you~♪
choice_data_list: I need to find some reference books!
A read-aloud... I'd love to hear one...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, right...!
I'm so sorry, doing this over and over~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I-I got a bit carried away too... We need to search properly, right...!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, Classical Japanese... Classical Japanese is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... "The Boss Pig and His 'Minion' Wolf,"
it says. This might be nice for a story reading...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I think you have the wrong kind of "minion"...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry~!
Jeez, what is wrong with me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Super Creek searched for study guides while desperately battling her surging maternal instincts...!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll read it to you too, Trainer-san.
Here we go~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Once upon a time... a bad dragon living in the mountains attacked a village and troubled everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san's voice... is so soothing.
Somehow, my strength is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it's perfectly fine if you drift off to sleep~.
There, the~re♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, feeling refreshed from the storytelling,
Super Creek resumed her search for reference books.
